# Offers for the “Day the Bombs Fell” anniversary

![](/uploads/ajaxGallery_232_nukaknights-post-bombs-drop-anniversary-2023-offers.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

## The day the bombs fell

October 23, 2077 was the day the bombs fell and the Great War (Sino-American War between America and China) broke out. This thermonuclear world war led to the collapse of the world at that time in just 2 hours. America and the rest of the world was turned into a "wasteland" that day. The effects of this war are still felt 200 years later.

See Wiki: Great War

## Free Play Event

From October 24th - October 31, 2023, Fallout 76 will be playable for free on all platforms.

![](/uploads/fallout76-free-play-event-2023.jpg)

## Fallout 76 discount -80%

Until October 31st, 2023 you can get Fallout 76 in the latest version for just €7.99 (-80%). Future updates are always included for free with Fallout 76.

## The PITT Recruitment Bundle: New offers

Currently The P.I.T.T. Recruitment bundle again on offer on Xbox, Playstation and PC for €14.99 until October 31, 2023.

See: The PITT Recruitment Bundle (Current Offers)

## Atom packages offers

The Atom Bundle packages are also on offer with a **20 - 35% discount** until October 31, 2023

- **500 atoms** : €3.99 (-20%)
- **1100 atoms** : €7.49 (-25%)
- **2400 atoms** : €13.49 (-30%)
- **5000 atoms** : €25.49 (-35%)

## Free Xbox GamePass Ultimate & Prime Gaming Bundle

![Fallout 76 Birthday Bundle](/uploads/fallout76-prime-gaming-birthday-bundle.jpg) 

Until January 17th, 2024 you will receive the free birthday bundle with Prime Gaming and GamePass Ultimate (in the benefits) with the following content:

- Vault Boy Fireworks Stand
- American bowling alley
- Vault Boy 5th Anniversary Photo Frame
- Safe technology quilt
- VTU doctoral hat
- Vault Boy Memorial Lamp

## Continue Fallout games on offer until October 31, 2023

- **Fallout 4: Game of the Year Edition** for 9.99 (-75%)
- **Fallout 4: DLS** (-60%)
- **Fallout 3** for €2.49 (-75%)
- **Fallout New Vegas** for €2.49 (-75%)

Further offers will follow here in the article as soon as more is announced.
